item.title: Heron
item.description:
An ancient dragon. The truth-teller.

Beyond

He reveals the real history: the unicorns built the obelisk, the rainbows drain life, the dragons were broken and now sustain Nephimhr with their own essence and are bound there. “In that moment of release, we found we could act.” He survives and reclaims the mountains.

item.title: Issah
item.description:
Mercenary. Deadpan, economical, a death-wish underneath. Travels east with Eri.

Beyond

His little brother Urmez starved to death in his arms. He earned the Dragon Slayer title through Malachar’s willing sacrifice. He kills Rhodes at the climax.
